title: Captured session tool-discovery fixture
description: Schema for fixtures under tests/fixtures/session-tool-discovery/. Each fixture captures an adapter's tools/list result independently of this repo's manifest source, so compatibility checks can compare 'globally registered' against 'actually discoverable in a session' without deriving one from the other.

discoveredTools.description: The literal tool names an agent session could actually call via tools/list, as observed/captured for this adapter state. Deliberately a flat string list independent of any manifest-derived type, so drift between registration and discovery is detectable.
